name: omp-semantic-policy
description: Semantic policy enforcement for Oh My Pi

showStatus.description: Show semantic policy state in OMP's native status bar.

showViolationFeedback.description: Show action-bound feedback for direct actions and workflow checks. Blocked tool calls always include policy feedback in their originating tool card, without session-wide notifications.

confirmationDefault.description: Resolve confirmation requests automatically when no dialog is selected. Approve (default) accepts uncertainty, including unavailable-evaluator fallbacks; deny opts into fail-closed behavior. Explicit policy denials remain blocked.

confirmationThreshold.description: The default 1 keeps decisions automatic without dialogs, using confirmationDefault (approve by default). Set below 1 to prompt at or above that confidence; 0 prompts for every uncertain checked action. Session-stop workflow checks always resolve automatically. Explicitly selected prompts block without an interactive UI.

enabledToolCalls.description: Comma-separated exact OMP tool names for remote semantic evaluation. Defaults to mutation, execution, delegation, and process-control tools; routine inspection and lsp (including write to xd://lsp) skip TypeSafe. Local path protections and intent checks remain active. Explicitly empty evaluates every tool call.

disabledToolCalls.description: Comma-separated exact OMP tool names that skip remote semantic evaluation, for example bash. Local protections remain active. Empty keeps all current remote enforcement defaults.

scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
